arguments.subject: Payment reminder for invoice AC-2026-9395
arguments.body:
Dear Calder Fasteners Ltd,

We would like to remind you that invoice AC-2026-9395, with an open amount of 1021.0, was due on 2026-10-05 and is now 53 days overdue.

Please arrange payment at your earliest convenience.

Kind regards,
